# Will this pen of calves make money?

> Free stocker and backgrounding calculator: margin per head, break-even sale price and purchase price, cost of gain against value of gain with a price slide, death loss and interest. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/stocker-cattle-margin-calculator/)
